sections.text:
PyNE in this environment is built without PyMOAB, so `pyne.variancereduction.magic`
cannot be called directly. The comparison below uses a pure-Python reimplementation
of PyNE's documented MAGIC formula.

Nucleide's MAGIC output matched the reference formula exactly for the synthetic
test tally.

The per-group MAGIC output was also emitted as an OpenMC settings.xml fragment
(`<mesh>` + `<weight_windows>`) and as a Serpent-readable WWINP file (`wwin ... wf`)
and each emitted text was re-parsed structurally back to the MAGIC windows.

rows: PASS: openmc.MeshBase/openmc.WeightWindows parsed the emitted fragment
SKIP: Serpent is proprietary and not installed; the WWINP FMT=2 spelling is verified by the in-tree reader round-trip instead

sections.text:
The Serpent file is emitted in the MCNP WWINP text spelling that Serpent reads via
`wwin <name> wf "<file>" 2`; the returned card pins that reference:
`wwin ww1 wf "wwindows.wwd" 2`.
